scope: Cochrane, The Fiscal Theory of the Price Level, Chapter 16 (with Chapter 12 and Online Appendix A3 parts): Equilibrium selection in new Keynesian models. Innovation operators; the simplest model (16.1)-(16.11) with its sunspot family, determinacy iff |phi|>1, the AR(1) solution and the Wicksellian rule ((16.8) corrected); the King form and its translation bijection; nominal hyperinflations satisfy the TVC under passive fiscal policy while the FTPL rules out real explosions; non-identification NI-1 to NI-4 with finite-sample OLS/IV identities and learnability; observational equivalence of NK and FTPL equilibria (E6 corrected: passive iff gamma = alpha); responses (Fisherian, super-Fisherian, open mouth); global dynamics at the lower bound with the second steady state (E2 corrected, tangency counterexample); selection patches (MSV, ACK, BSGU, Woodford mu-bar, Bassetto, V-shaped rules, SGU, Sims 1994, bounded-rule finite-time explosion); Sims' tiny fiscal model (E1 corrected: TVC fails iff phi >= R); links to Woodford Ch2 and Ch4 Prop 4.11. Printed errors corrected with Lean counterexamples.
source: John H. Cochrane, The Fiscal Theory of the Price Level, Princeton University Press, Chapter 16, pp. 363-396, Chapter 12, pp. 324-328, and Online Appendix A3, pp. 613-616.
